title: Zero to Million - Episode 5
caption:
Episode 5 of Zero to Million. 🖨️💸

You picked the kid for $50 a day. He printed 100 flyers ($12)… with one typo: $2 instead of $20. 38 customers, $76. Balance: $337.

Next vote:
A) Keep $2 (100 people, $200 minus $50)
B) Back to $20, no kid (11 customers, $220)
Comment A or B. Send this to your future millionaire friend. Follow for part 6!
